title: Authored Doc Frontmatter v1
description: YAML frontmatter contract for authored skill (skills/<name>/SKILL.md) and reference (references/<name>.md) docs. Markdown bodies cannot be fully schema-validated, so this schemas the frontmatter; structural body checks and the faithfulness/quote-scan guards cover the rest. Step 8.

provenance.description: What the authored body is derived from. Empty arrays are valid (Tier 0 bodies have no principle/claim layer).
